name: Mauritius

flag.description: Four equal horizontal stripes of red, blue, yellow and green.
flag.symbolism: Red represents the struggle for independence, blue the Indian Ocean, yellow the light of independence, and green agriculture and the island's greenery.

hook: Mauritius stacks four equal stripes top to bottom like an island view: red sunset, blue ocean, yellow sand, green sugar cane.
trivia: Mauritius was the only home of the dodo, which was extinct by the late 17th century.
The 1847 'Blue Mauritius' stamps are among the rarest and most valuable stamps in the world.
